3. Narrow down the list of possible anions based on the identified cation and sample's pH.

Most experiments will consume a portion of the involved solutions, including the unknown sample. If you run out of the sample, you cannot perform any tests that use it but you can keep experimenting with other solutions in the Inventory from the previously performed tests.
